_comment: Generic policy template. Copy to policy.json and fill in host-specific values,
OR keep ${VAR} placeholders here and set those vars in your .env file.
The service expands ${ENV_VAR} references at load time using os.environ.
Available SSH defaults (set in .env, apply to hosts that omit the field):

ps_named.description: List processes whose full command line matches a pattern

args: timeout 3 bash -c '</dev/tcp/{target_host}/{target_port}' && echo open || echo closed

getent_hosts.description: Resolve a host name through NSS

df_path.description: Disk space for a specific path

neovim_introspection.description: Read-only Neovim and Mason installation introspection

nvim_version.description: Show the installed Neovim version and build information

nvim_stdpaths.description: Show Neovim standard config, data, state, and cache paths

args: +lua local ok,items=pcall(function() return vim.pack.get(nil,{offline=true}) end); if ok then print(vim.json.encode(items)) else print('vim.pack unavailable') end
nvim_pack_get.description: List plugins managed by Neovim's native vim.pack package manager

args: set -u; data="$HOME/.local/share/nvim"; echo "nvim=$(command -v nvim || true)"; echo "python=$(command -v python || true)"; echo "python3=$(command -v python3 || true)"; echo "debugpy_pkg=$data/mason/packages/debugpy"; ls -la "$data/mason/packages/debugpy" 2>&1 || true; ls -la "$data/mason/packages/debugpy/venv/bin" 2>&1 || true; echo "debugpy-adapter-bin=$data/mason/bin/debugpy-adapter"; "$data/mason/bin/debugpy-adapter" --help 2>&1 | head -20 || true; echo "venv-python-debugpy-adapter"; "$data/mason/packages/debugpy/venv/bin/python" -m debugpy.adapter --help 2>&1 | head -20 || true
nvim_dap_python_probe.description: Probe Mason debugpy executable layout and adapter startup behavior

args: +lua local ok, dap = pcall(require, 'dap'); print('dap_require=' .. tostring(ok)); if ok then print('adapter_python_type=' .. type(dap.adapters.python)); print('config_python_type=' .. type(dap.configurations.python)); print('config_python_count=' .. tostring(dap.configurations.python and #dap.configurations.python or 0)); if dap.configurations.python then for i,c in ipairs(dap.configurations.python) do print(i .. ':' .. tostring(c.name) .. ':' .. tostring(c.type) .. ':' .. tostring(c.request)) end end end
nvim_dap_runtime_probe.description: Probe loaded nvim-dap Python adapter and configuration state

args: for f in "$HOME/.cache/nvim/dap.log" "$HOME/.local/state/nvim/dap.log" "$HOME/.local/state/nvim/log" "$HOME/.local/state/nvim/nvim.log"; do echo "== $f =="; if [ -f "$f" ]; then tail -120 "$f"; else echo missing; fi; done
nvim_dap_logs.description: Read recent Neovim and nvim-dap log output from standard state/cache locations

nvim_lua_dirs.description: List Neovim Lua configuration directories under ~/.config/nvim/lua

nvim_lua_files.description: List Neovim Lua configuration files under ~/.config/nvim/lua

nvim_read_lua_file.description: Read a Lua configuration file under ~/.config/nvim/lua by relative path

mason_bin_links.description: List Mason bin entries and symlink targets
